author: Paul
authorNote: The letter names Paul as author. Many modern scholars think 1 and 2 Timothy and Titus were written by a follower of Paul after his death; many others hold that Paul wrote them.
overview: Written as Paul faces death in prison, this is a farewell letter. He urges Timothy to be strong, guard the good news, and keep teaching the Scriptures, which are "God-breathed". "I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race."
